🇺🇸 🇺🇦 🇷🇺 Kushner: "Article 5-like" guarantees for Ukraine, but only inside a new European security deal Jared Kushner, Trump's son-in-law, who is working on the Ukraine talks alongside special envoy Steve Witkoff, has laid out Washington's thinking on security guarantees in a long post on X. He says Trump is willing to consider "Article 5-like" guarantees for Ukraine, and calls Russia's readiness to discuss them "a major step forward" and a sign Moscow is serious about peace. He agrees with Zelensky that any guarantee must be specific, credible and clearly documented. But he attaches conditions. Trump would have to personally approve any guarantee, subject to the constitutional process and Congress, and would only do so if it clearly served US interests and the wider arrangements made it "highly unlikely" the guarantee would ever be used. That's why, Kushner says, guarantees for Ukraine can't be settled separately from a new post-war European security architecture. He wants to identify where existing mechanisms "failed to prevent this war" and build permanent channels for consultation, crisis communication, military deconfliction, greater transparency and reciprocal steps to reduce escalation. The goal, in his words, is a Europe where Russia is confident NATO isn't seeking confrontation, and NATO is confident Russia will respect its neighbors. He adds that Ukraine needs a long-term prosperity plan and reforms, and that American and European commitments "must be matched by Ukraine's commitment to its own success." Talks with Ukraine, Europe and Russia will continue in the coming weeks, and "nothing is agreed until it is agreed." Notably, Kushner posted this as a quote of Zelensky's post calling NATO membership the clearest guarantee, and he never mentions NATO membership at all. Also worth remembering: Article 5 itself doesn't oblige anyone to fight. Each member only commits to take "such action as it deems necessary." An "Article 5-like" guarantee would likely be just as optional. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

🟡 Current Updates: November 22-23, 2026 🇾🇪 Yemen Saudi airstrikes on Hattab Market in the Baqim district, northwest of Saada, killed four civilians and injured nine others, including African migrants, according to local Yemeni sources. Saudi warplanes also targeted a house in the Zarqa area of Al-Maqatirah district, north of Lahij Governorate in southern Yemen. Meanwhile, Brigadier General Yahya Saree announced that the Yemeni Armed Forces had carried out two military operations. The first targeted the Petro Rabigh oil refinery in Saudi Arabia, scoring a direct hit, while the second targeted a radar installation in the Wadi al-Dawasir area in two stages, successfully achieving its objective. Separately, Saudi aircraft carried out four airstrikes on the Al-Athawir and Al-A’bus areas in Hayfan district, south of Taiz. A drone attack also targeted southern Saudi Arabia, while local sources reported Saudi aggression against the capital, Sanaa. 🇮🇷 Iran Iranian or Iran-linked vessels, including the liquefied natural gas tanker Tanya Star , reportedly activated their Automatic Identification System (AIS) transponders and began appearing in the Gulf of Oman, directly opposite the line of the American naval blockade. Meanwhile, air defence systems were activated in Sirik, Hormozgan Province, southern Iran. Field reports confirmed the activation, but no further details were available regarding the nature of the potential targets or the reason for the alert. 🌊 Strait of Hormuz A body wearing a sailor’s uniform was found in the Strait of Hormuz near Khasab, Oman. Separately, the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) received a report of an incident involving a tanker and military forces in the Gulf of Oman. Vessels were advised to monitor the latest maritime security information and remain alert to the evolving operational situation. The relevant authorities were informed, and investigations were ongoing. 🇰🇼 Kuwait A major oil spill was reported off the Kuwaiti coast, with the incident said to have begun on November 20. The cause of the spill remained unknown, while the resulting contamination had reportedly spread along the country’s coastline. 🇱🇾 Libya The Libyan Army announced that it had foiled another attack targeting the coast of Benghazi. 🇵🇸 Palestine Hamas reportedly executed two Palestinians in Khan Younis on charges of collaborating with israel and providing information that led to the killing of Palestinian military personnel. According to reports from Gaza, information supplied by one of the accused had also led to the killing of his own brother. 🔹 @enemywatch

России выгодна потеря доверия украинцев к государственным институтам: Коберник обратила внимание на опасное последствие Главный редактор "Бабеля" Екатерина Коберник связала вопрос общественного доверия к украинским государственным институтам с интересами России. Комментируя резонансные расследования НАБУ и САП, журналистка предложила оценивать не только информацию, которая становится известна общественности, но и то, как она влияет на отношение граждан к государству. По её оценке, ослабление доверия украинцев к собственным институтам отвечает интересам РФ , которая прилагает усилия для достижения такого результата. "Выгодно России, чтобы в Украине не было доверия к институтам? Очень выгодно. Она работает над этим всеми силами", — заявила Коберник. При этом журналистка не утверждала, что сами расследования проводятся в интересах России. Её комментарий касался последствий для общественного доверия и того, кому может быть выгодно его ослабление. 🇺🇦 INSIDER UA | Прислать контент

📡 Pakistani PM to visit Russia, Iran to invite presidents to SCO summit in Islamabad: Reports 📌 Islamabad, IRNA - Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif will make key visits to Russia and Iran, where he will invite the presidents of both countries to attend the upcoming Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) summit of heads of state in Islamabad, according to reports. Sharif will begin his official visit to Moscow on November 30, Pakistani media reported, citing diplomatic sources in Islamabad. ​ The visit comes after Sharif was forced to cancel a planned trip to Moscow last March, a week into the US-Israeli war of aggression, despite an invitation from Russian President Vladimir Putin. ​ In Moscow, Sharif will meet Putin to discuss bilateral issues, with a focus on expanding defense, security and economic cooperation, particularly on Russian energy capacity, the sources said. ​ Sharif is also expected to present a formal invitation to the Russian president to attend the next SCO heads of state summit, to be hosted by Islamabad in summer 2027. ​ A similar invitation is expected to be delivered to Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian during Sharif’s visit to Tehran, according to the report. 📲 @Irna_en ​
